summary: An index on its cash exchange's scrip key (NSE|26000): Quote with OHLC and the change, which the desktop works out from the close and sends under its canonical names with the web's aliases.

notes: Definedge sends no volume, average price or book totals for an index; both sides leave them out.
The percent change is chosen to agree with the close to two places, which the desktop recomputes.

deviations.reason: Definedge's web adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: data.mode follows the broker's own web adapter, in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Definedge: integer).

The web forwards Definedge's raw time as ltt: the feed time `ft` in epoch seconds (or the depth feed's clock text HH:MM:SS), a wrong value where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md); it is a JSON string as well. The desktop sends the epoch ms value.
price_change is the desktop's canonical name for an index's change (the recorded Zerodha transcript's); this web adapter sends the percent only.
price_change_percent is the desktop's canonical name for an index's percent change; the web adapter's own names change_percent and percent_change are sent beside it as aliases.
